brief: Rose was the first canonised saint of the Americas. She was born in 1586 in Lima to parents of Spanish descent. She had an ardent love of God and, reckoning that anything that might endanger that love must be rooted out of her life, she imposed upon herself severe austerity and mortification. Objections and ridicule from her family and friends did nothing to dissuade her. In the last years of her life Rose cared for homeless children, the elderly and the sick. She died at the age of 31 in 1617.
